scope: Automation transport resilience: liveness-probe watchdog replacing request-timeout-equals-dead-child, bounded client read/mutation lanes beside priority work, caller-abort release with late-response frame matching, provider intent-ledger arbitration of refused submits (dispatch-failed), reply-loop auto-reconcile from positive run evidence, extended plan/run/event windows, and journaled intake drops.

rounds.design: Kill the child when any invoke exceeds the request watchdog; serialize all non-priority invokes behind one chain; treat every submit failure as indeterminate; drop intake ignores silently; 120s plan/run/event budgets.
blockers: A saturated serialized lane makes every invoke exceed 180s: the watchdog then kills a healthy child, the respawn re-verifies pins under load, dies the same way, and the connector never converges — observed as a live respawn loop on the owner host.

Submit failure -> indeterminate with no arbitration surface: a response lost after the server refused the dispatch could never be distinguished from a real in-flight send, so contacts wedged until manual reconcile.
Stale drops at intake left no journal record, and the 120s event window silently discarded every inbound the slow lane surfaced late.

rounds.design: Stall triggers a priority-lane cancel probe (probe:watchdog); any protocol response re-arms the invoke and only probe silence stops the child; invoke hard cap releases unresolved ops while keeping wire entries for late responses; read/mutation lanes with bounded waiters beside the priority path; run.by-intent arbitrates refused submits; reconcile settles only on terminal provider evidence; intake drops journal under a namespaced drop:<eventId>.
blockers: Wiring caller-signal release into submit would discard the authoritative late response the client deliberately retains custody of — fixed by exempting submit from abort-release while keeping its pre-dispatch abort check.

Client read-lane methods (events, enrollments, status, run, grant lookups) outpaced the server's scoped-admission list and would collide on normalBusy -> not-ready under concurrency — fixed by aligning the server scoped set.
runByIntent called through .catch on a fixture or older client without the method throws synchronously before catch attaches — fixed by wrapping invocation in Promise.resolve().then().
ackReceipt.value dereferenced after a failed receipt — fixed by gating all access on ackReceipt.ok and mapping only dispatch-failed to a provable skip.
Initial wakeLane order let a sustained read flood cut ahead of a queued submit — fixed by claiming freed wire slots for mutation waiters first.

Ack-branch reconcile could claim non-send while a reply row existed but unreadable/nonterminal — fixed by gating ack arbitration on reply === null (provable absence), matching the structural guarantee that an ack-wedged run never composed a reply.
acceptedNits: Probe uses cancel with a reserved plan id: unknown-plan cancel returns a result or bounded remote error, both prove liveness; a child answering probes but never the invoke is abandoned only at the 15-minute hard cap.
Abandoned wire entries stay in pending until the response so frame matching cannot fault; they are bounded because a child that never answers eventually trips the probe watchdog or exits.
dispatch-failed is issued only on provider-stage refusal with a proven-absent intent row — a response lost after commit still finds the terminal or started row and stays indeterminate.
Intake drop journaling uses drop:<eventId> under the UNIQUE(contactId,eventId) claim so it can never collide with or replay the original event.
rounds.verification: 655 textbutler+transport tests green including new stall/probe, lane, abort-matching, disambiguation, reconcile and stale-window coverage; ghostget server tests green for run.by-intent and scoped reads (pre-existing bound-state-helper spawn failures reproduce identically on clean HEAD under host load); typecheck clean on both trees.

result: Ship. A slow lane no longer reads as a dead child, reads proceed beside held sends, provable non-sends fail clean instead of wedging contacts, auto-reconcile settles only on positive provider evidence, and pipeline-trouble intake drops are journaled instead of silent.
